name: Golden cross (SMA50>SMA200)
description: Classic long-term trend turn: 50-day mean crosses above the 200-day.

name: Reclaim 200-day
description: Price crosses back above the 200-day on volume — regime change to bullish.

name: EMA 9/20 bull cross
description: Fast EMA crosses slow while above the 50-day — short trend resumption.

name: ADX strong uptrend
description: ADX>25 with +DI over -DI confirms a real (not chop) uptrend.

name: Triple EMA alignment
description: Stacked EMAs (9>20>50) with price reclaiming the fast line.

name: MACD cross above zero
description: MACD line crosses above the zero line — momentum turns net-positive.

name: Donchian 55 breakout (turtle)
description: Turtle-style 55-day channel breakout in a trending name.

name: Rising SMA100 trend
description: Pullback reclaim of the 20-day while the 100-day slopes up.

name: Trend pullback to 20MA
description: Uptrend name pulling back into the lower-middle Bollinger band, RSI cooling.

name: SMA20 slope-up dip buy
description: Dip back above a rising 20-day inside an uptrend.

name: 20d momentum continuation
description: Strong 20-day gain, still above the 20-day and not yet overbought.

name: RSI strength band
description: RSI in the bullish 55-68 zone with positive MACD histogram.

name: 20d high + volume
description: New 20-day high confirmed by a volume surge.

name: 50d high breakout
description: Breakout to a fresh ~50-day high.

name: MACD histogram turning up
description: MACD histogram flips positive above the 50-day.

name: 3-day thrust above 20MA
description: Short sharp thrust with follow-through above the 20-day.

name: Gap-up hold
description: Opens up on volume and closes at/above the open — news-driven continuation.

name: Relative-strength leader
description: Top-quartile 60-day performer still trending, not overbought.

name: RSI(2) mean reversion
description: Connors RSI(2) deeply oversold while the long-term trend is up.

name: RSI oversold bounce
description: First up-day after RSI dipped below 30.

name: Bollinger lower reclaim
description: Tags/pierces the lower band then closes back up.

name: Williams %R reversal
description: Williams %R exits oversold in a long-term uptrend.

name: CCI oversold snapback
description: CCI crosses back above -100 while above the 50-day.

name: Stochastic oversold cross
description: %K crosses %D from below 25 in an uptrend.

name: 2-ATR stretch below 20MA
description: Stretched below the band but holding the long-term trend.

name: Deep pullback in uptrend
description: Sharp dip toward support in a name that's still above its 200-day.

name: Lower band + RSI<35
description: Lower-band + oversold RSI while above the 100-day.

name: Bollinger squeeze breakout
description: Volatility contraction (narrow bands) then an upside expansion on volume.

name: Volume-spike breakout
description: 2x-average volume driving a 20-day high, closing strong.

name: 52-week high breakout
description: New 52-week high — strongest names make new highs.

name: ATR expansion up-close
description: Range expands with an up close on volume — start of a move.

name: OBV accumulation
description: On-balance-volume turns up through its average — buyers stepping in.

name: Low-volatility pullback
description: Quiet pullback reclaiming the fast EMA in a calm uptrend.

name: %b momentum ride
description: %b pushes above 0.8 with trend confirmation.

name: RSI + MACD combo
description: RSI reclaims 50 with a positive MACD histogram.

name: Stochastic cross in uptrend
description: Mid-range stochastic bull cross while trending.

name: RSI reclaim 50
description: Momentum flips bullish as RSI crosses back above 50.

name: MACD cross + RSI>50
description: MACD signal-line cross confirmed by RSI over 50.

name: CCI zero-line cross
description: CCI crosses zero into positive territory with trend.

name: Williams %R mid cross
description: %R crosses the -50 midline upward in an uptrend.

name: MACD signal cross (trend)
description: Signal-line cross while MACD is already positive.

name: Consolidation break
description: Tight consolidation resolving to the upside.

name: +DI crosses -DI
description: Directional index flips bullish with trend strength.

name: EMA20 bounce
description: Bounce off the 20-EMA with EMAs stacked bullishly.

name: Quiet new high
description: Orderly (low-volatility) breakout to a 20-day high in a trend.

name: MACD histogram accel
description: Momentum accelerating (rising positive histogram) with RSI support.

name: Stochastic reclaim 50
description: %K reclaims the 50 midline with MACD support.

name: Trend + momentum combo
description: Above both major MAs with fresh positive momentum — high-conviction long.

name: Dry-up then surge
description: Volume dries up (tight bands) then a surge with a strong close.

name: ADX rising trend entry
description: Trend strengthening (ADX rising) with a fast-EMA reclaim.

name: ROC acceleration
description: Both short and medium ROC positive and building.

name: Band walk (upper)
description: Price walking the upper band in a strong trend (momentum persistence).

name: Donchian 20 break, volume confirmed
description: Breaks the 20-day channel top on heavy volume while already in an uptrend - the breakout that has participation behind it.

name: Squeeze release, upside
description: Volatility compressed into the bottom 15% of its range, then price breaks the upper band - the classic coil release.

name: Volume leads price
description: On-balance volume is accumulating while price still sits below its 20-day mean - buying that has not yet shown up in the price.

name: Golden-cross pullback
description: Long-term trend intact, price reclaims its short mean without being overbought - buying the dip inside a confirmed uptrend.

name: RSI(2) washout in an uptrend
description: A two-day washout inside a long-term uptrend - the short-horizon mean-reversion setup, only where the primary trend still holds.

name: Trend strength turning up
description: ADX crossing up through 20 with buyers in control - a trend beginning to organise rather than one already extended.

name: Stochastic reclaim from oversold
description: Stochastic turns up out of oversold while price holds its 100-day mean - a bounce with the longer trend still intact.

name: Long-run leader, short pullback
description: Strong over three months, soft over two weeks, still above its 50-day - buying a pause in a genuine leader.

name: Band reclaim from the low
description: Price climbs back off the lower Bollinger band on rising volume, with the long-term trend still up.

name: New 52-week high, low volatility
description: A 52-week high made calmly rather than in a spike - breakouts from quiet bases historically behave differently from panic highs.

name: MACD reclaims zero
description: Momentum crosses from negative to positive with the histogram confirming - the turn, not the extension.

name: 50-day EMA defended
description: Price dipped below the 50-day EMA intraday and closed back above it, inside a longer uptrend - the level held.

name: Williams %R reset in trend
description: An oversold reset inside a trending market rather than a falling one.

name: Volume dry-up then surge
description: Volume more than doubles on an up day above the 20-day mean - a decisive re-entry of buyers.

name: CCI pullback in uptrend
description: CCI turning up out of oversold with three-month momentum still positive.

name: Donchian 55 breakout
description: The classic long-horizon turtle channel break, filtered for an actually trending market.

name: Triple screen alignment
description: Long-term trend up, medium-term momentum positive, short-term oscillator still low - the three-timeframe agreement setup.

name: Quiet base, upside break
description: A breakout out of a genuinely quiet base - low ATR before the move, not after it.
